item.title: Deadline for tax return submission extended again
item.description: Dhaka – The government has extended the deadline for submitting income tax returns for the 2025-26 fiscal year by an additional month for individual taxpayers and Hindu undivided families. item.description: Dhaka – The government has announced a three-day state mourning to honor former prime minister Khaleda Zia.
